scripts.start: npm run setup && npm run godot && npm run build && npm run import && node scripts/godot.mjs --path game
scripts.export:web: npm run godot && npm run import && node scripts/godot.mjs --headless --path game --export-release Web ../Builds/WebGL/index.html
scripts.deploy:web: npm run export:web && node scripts/web/pack.mjs Builds/WebGL && npx --yes wrangler deploy
